mapper.sql: case mp.target_type when 'ROLE' then (select r.role_name from roles r where r.role_code = mp.target_id) when 'ORGANIZATION' then (select o.organization_name from organizations o where o.organization_code = mp.target_id) when 'USER' then (select coalesce(k.name, u.login_id) from users u left join korus_personnel_snapshots k on k.employee_no = u.employee_no where cast(u.user_id as varchar) = mp.target_id) else mp.target_id end

select mp.permission_id as "permissionId", mp.target_type as "targetType", mp.target_id as "targetId", as "targetName", screen.menu_id as "menuId", top.menu_name as "topMenuName", middle.menu_name as "middleMenuName", screen.menu_name as "screenMenuName", screen.screen_id as "screenId", screen.url as "url", mp.access_allowed as "accessAllowed", mp.status as "status", mp.change_reason as "changeReason", mp.updated_at as "updatedAt" from menu_permissions mp join menus screen on screen.menu_id = mp.menu_id left join menus middle on middle.menu_id = screen.parent_menu_id left join menus top on top.menu_id = middle.parent_menu_id
mapper.select: select count(*) from menus where menu_id = #{menuId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and system_use_yn = 'Y'

choose.when: select count(*) from roles where role_code = #{targetId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and system_use_yn = 'Y'
select count(*) from organizations where organization_code = #{targetId} and status != 'DELETED'
select count(*) from users where cast(user_id as varchar) = #{targetId} and status != 'DELETED'

mapper.insert: insert into menu_permissions (target_type, target_id, menu_id, access_allowed, status, created_by, updated_by, change_reason) values (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{menuId}, #{accessAllowed}, 'ACTIVE', #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{changeReason}) on conflict (target_type, target_id, menu_id) do update set access_allowed = EXCLUDED.access_allowed, status = 'ACTIVE', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason
